title: Concurrent Chat/set create for same contactId returns server error
description: kith-store/src/chat.rs:56: create() generates a ULID, calls INSERT OR IGNORE (silently ignored if contact_id already has a row), then calls get(that_ulid) which returns None because the ULID was never written. This bubbles up as KithError::Store('chat not found after insert') → JmapError::server_fail. The second concurrent Chat/set create for the same contact gets a spurious 500 for a valid request.
